name: The Hoff: When Scott Came to Stay
original_name: The Hoff: When Scott Came to Stay
overview: The Hoff: When Scott Came To Stay follows BBC Radio 1 DJ Scott Mills as he flies out to L.A. to spend four manic days living the colorful life of legendary Baywatch and Knight Rider star, David Hasselhoff. It's one thing meeting your idol, quite another actually living with them and in their own home!
